candidates.name: Geoscience Markup Language (GeoSciML)
verified_facts: GeoSciML defines a logical model and GML/XML encoding for exchanging geological map data, geological time scales, boreholes and laboratory-analysis metadata.
It includes profiles for simple map applications, INSPIRE-aligned exchange and more complex geoscience scenarios.
semantic_limits: A geological feature or borehole exchange model does not establish the bare-earth surface elevation, LiDAR acquisition accuracy or parcel-specific DTM sample used by this task.

candidates.name: LAS Specification
verified_facts: LAS is an open format intended for LiDAR and other point-cloud data records.
The format commonly carries XYZ points produced from GPS, IMU and laser-pulse range processing so different hardware and software can exchange point clouds.
semantic_limits: LAS format conformance alone does not prove point classification, bare-earth filtering, vertical datum, survey epoch or vertical accuracy and cannot silently promote a point cloud to the canonical DTM result.
